'''David James Payne''' (12 October 1931 – 8 March 2014) was an [[Anglican]] priest. Payne held the rectorships of [[Shackleford]], [[Peper Harow]] and [[Odell, Bedfordshire|Odell]], and the vicarship of [[Pavenham]] at various points. He was Warden of the Divine Healing Mission from 1978 to 1984.<ref name="David James Payne on Crockford">{{Crockford| surname=Payne | forenames=David James | id=36785}}</ref>

==Early life and education==
Payne was born in [[St John's Wood, London]] on 12 October 1931. He attended [[Sherborne School]], an independent boarding school in [[Dorset]],<ref>{{cite journal |author=<!--Staff writer(s); no by-line.--> |date=2000 |title=THE OLD SHIRBURNIAN SOCIETY |url=https://www.oldshirburnian.org.uk/pdf_files/os_register-7th-edition.pdf |journal=The Shirburnian |volume=7 |page=70 |access-date=10 September 2023}}</ref> before completing [[national service]] with the [[Durham Light Infantry]] in Egypt.<ref name="ODELL CHURCH NEWS">[https://www.odellbeds.net/c14my.htm Rev David Payne, 12th October 1931 – 8th March 2014] at ALL SAINTS' ODELL CHURCH NEWS - May 2014</ref> In 1951, he proceeded to [[Clare College, Cambridge]], where he completed a [[Bachelor of Arts|B.A.]] in 1954 and [[Master of Arts|M.A.]] in 1961 in the [[natural sciences]].<ref name="Clare Association">{{cite journal |author=<!--Staff writer(s); no by-line.--> |date=9 February 2015 |title=Obituaries |url=https://www.crowhursthealing.org.uk/downloads/Corwhurst-Summer-2014.pdf |journal=The Clare Association |page=103 |access-date=10 September 2023}}</ref>

Payne spent three years as a biology master at [[Mill Hill School]] and [[Marlborough College]]. In 1958, he began work at [[Lee Abbey]], Devon, and promptly trained for ordination at [[Wycliffe Hall, Oxford]], graduating with a [[Bachelor of Arts|B.A. (Hons)]] in 1960.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Crook |first1=Colin |date=Summer 2014 |title=Tribute to Revd David Payne |url=https://www.crowhursthealing.org.uk/downloads/Corwhurst-Summer-2014.pdf |journal=Crowhurst Christian Healing Centre |page=10 |access-date=10 September 2023}}</ref>

==Ordained ministry==
Payne was ordained as a deacon in 1962 at [[Christ Church, Oxford]] by [[Harry Carpenter (bishop)|Harry Carpenter]], Bishop of Oxford, and as a priest in 1963 at [[Guildford Cathedral]] by [[George Reindorp]], Bishop of Guildford.<ref name="David James Payne on Crockford"/> He began his career as a curate at [[Great Faringdon]] from 1962 to 1963 and Christ Church, [[Guildford]] from 1963 to 1966. In 1966, he was appointed to two rectorships: [[Shackleford]] and [[Peper Harow]],<ref>{{cite magazine | url=http://www.hambledonsurrey.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/parish-mags-old/March%201967.pdf | magazine=Parish Magazine | title=St. Peter's Church, Hambledon | via=Hambledon Village | date=March 1967 | page=1 | accessdate=6 November 2024 }}</ref> which he left in 1973 to accept the rectorship of [[Odell, Bedfordshire|Odell]]<ref>[https://www.odellbeds.net/c8se.htm Reverend David Payne, Vicar of All Saints’ Odell] at CHURCH NEWS - September 2008</ref> and vicarship of [[Pavenham]].<ref>{{cite book |author=<!--Staff writer(s); no by-line.--> |date=2013 |title=Crockford's clerical directory 2014-2015 : a directory of the clergy of the Church of England, the Church in Wales, the Scottish Episcopal Church and the Church of Ireland |url=https://archive.org/details/crockfordscleric0000unse_b3s2/ |via=[[Internet Archive]] |publisher=[[Church House Publishing]] |page=617 |isbn=9780715110690}}</ref>

In 1978, Payne left Odell and Pavenham and was given the post of Warden of the Divine Healing Mission.{{#tag:ref|The Divine Healing Mission (later renamed the Crowhurst Christian Healing Centre) was a revival of the Ministry of Healing by the Church of England. It is located in [[Crowhurst, East Sussex]].|group="Note"}} In 1984, he left the Divine Healing Mission and was given the rectorship of [[Wraxall, Somerset]]. He retired to [[Cambridge]] in 1992.<ref>{{cite book |author=<!--Staff writer(s); no by-line.--> |date=1982 |title=UK Christian handbook |url=https://archive.org/details/ukchristianhandb0000unse_f5v9 |via=[[Internet Archive]] |publisher=London : Evangelical Alliance : Bible Society : MARC Europe |page=167 |isbn=9780950839608}}</ref>

==Death==
Payne died in [[Kentford|Kentford, Suffolk]] on 8 March 2014.<ref name="Clare Association"/> His funeral was held on 1 April at St Mary's Church, [[Burwell, Cambridgeshire|Burwell]].<ref name="ODELL CHURCH NEWS"/>
